settings.mjs holds the configuration constants for about thirty services, so the same setting name appears once per service (for example AUTH_MAX_RETRIES and BILLING_MAX_RETRIES). Make these twelve changes, each to the constant with exactly that name:

1. AUTH_MAX_RETRIES = 11
2. BILLING_TIMEOUT_MS = 45000
3. CATALOG_BATCH_SIZE = 750
4. SEARCH_CACHE_TTL_SECONDS = 7200
5. SHIPPING_ENABLED = false
6. REPORTS_DEBUG = true
7. INVENTORY_LOG_LEVEL = "trace"
8. GATEWAY_ENDPOINT = "https://gw.internal.example/v9"
9. QUEUE_POOL_SIZE = 64
10. MAILER_BACKOFF_FACTOR = 3.5
11. STORAGE_ALLOWED_METHODS = ["GET", "HEAD", "OPTIONS"]
12. TAX_REGION = "eu-north-1"

Change only those twelve values. Do not touch any other constant, comment, blank line or spacing in the file.
